answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a multisacle collaborative framework to ease the training of extremely deep NMT models. Specifically, instead of the top-most representation of the encoder stack, we attend the decoder to multi-granular source information with different space-scales.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluate IWSLT tasks with tokenized case-insensitive BLEU and report tokenized case-sensitive BLEU for WMT14 En→De.
